headline: TTCL and GEL post 33.3% 5‑day gains while KC drops 33.3% in one day
market_take: The coverage universe showed mixed momentum today. CONMAT’s GEL surged 33.33% on strong volume, offset by PROP’s KC falling 33.33% on thin trading. FOOD stocks were volatile – XBIO opened down 14.29% and AQUA swung +11.11% then -10.00% intraday. AGRI’s VPO rallied 9.09% with a 6.82x volume spike. Several high‑impact filings surfaced, including A5’s trading suspension, CPNCG’s capital reduction and AKS’s delisting warning.

GEL’s 33.33% rise dominates the sector; CPNCG disclosed a high‑impact capital reduction.
